questions.stem: Which of the following is defined as the average of the lower and upper class limits of a class?
questions.solution: The correct answer is 'Class mark' because it is calculated by averaging the lower and upper class limits. 'Class interval' refers to the difference between the upper and lower limits, 'class width' is another term for class interval, and 'class limit' refers to the individual boundaries of a class, not their average.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा एक वर्ग के निम्न और ऊपरी वर्ग सीमाओं के औसत के रूप में परिभाषित किया जाता है?
hi.solution: सही उत्तर 'वर्ग चिह्न' है क्योंकि इसे निम्न और ऊपरी वर्ग सीमाओं के औसत द्वारा गणना की जाती है। 'वर्ग अंतराल' ऊपरी और निम्न सीमाओं के अंतर को संदर्भित करता है, 'वर्ग चौड़ाई' वर्ग अंतराल के लिए एक अन्य शब्द है, और 'वर्ग सीमा' एक वर्ग की व्यक्तिगत सीमाओं को संदर्भित करता है, न कि उनके औसत को।

questions.stem: Which of the following is the total number of observations in a class?
questions.solution: The correct answer is 'Frequency' because it represents the total number of observations in a class. 'Class limit' refers to the boundaries of the class, 'class mark' is the midpoint between the limits, and 'class interval' is the width of the class.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन एक वर्ग में अवलोकनों की कुल संख्या है?

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of using a sub-divided bar diagram?
choices: To compare the total production of different years
To show the percentage of each component in the total
To compare the frequency of different categories in a single bar
To compare the production of two different crops in the same year
questions.solution: The main purpose of a sub-divided bar diagram is to show the percentage of each component in the total. This is because the diagram divides the bar into parts proportional to the entities being compared, making it easy to understand the contribution of each part to the whole. The other options are incorrect because they describe different types of diagrams or purposes not related to sub-divided bars.

hi.stem: एक उप-विभाजित बार आरेख का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या है?

questions.stem: Which of the following is a measure of central tendency?
questions.solution: Mean is a measure of central tendency because it represents the average value of a dataset. Frequency, cumulative frequency, and class interval are not measures of central tendency but rather tools used to organize or summarize data. The mean provides a single value that reflects the center of a data distribution.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा केंद्रीय प्रवृत्ति का माप है?
hi.solution: माध्य केंद्रीय प्रवृत्ति का एक माप है क्योंकि यह डेटा सेट के औसत मान का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है। बारंबारता, संचयी बारंबारता और वर्ग अंतराल केंद्रीय प्रवृत्ति के माप नहीं हैं, बल्कि डेटा के संगठन या सारांश के लिए उपयोग किए जाने वाले उपकरण हैं। माध्य डेटा वितरण के केंद्र को प्रतिबिंबित करने वाला एक एकल मान प्रदान करता है।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses standard statistical terminology as taught in Hindi-medium textbooks.

questions.stem: What is the term used for the average of all observations in a data set?
questions.solution: The term used for the average of all observations in a data set is 'Mean'. The mean is calculated by dividing the sum of all observations by the total number of observations. Median refers to the middle value, mode refers to the most frequent value, and range refers to the difference between the highest and lowest values.

hi.stem: एक डेटा सेट में सभी अवलोकनों के औसत के लिए प्रयुक्त शब्द क्या है?

hi.stem: दिए गए पाठ के आधार पर, विभिन्न राज्यों में लड़कों और लड़कियों के प्रतिशत को सबसे अच्छा दर्शाने वाला आरेख कौन-सा होगा?

questions.stem: If the number of observations is even, how is the median calculated?
choices: By taking the average of the middle two observations
questions.solution: When the number of observations is even, the median is calculated by taking the average of the middle two observations. This is because there is no single middle value. The other options are incorrect as they do not follow the definition of median.

questions.stem: In a frequency distribution table, the mode is defined as the value that appears most frequently. If two values appear with the same highest frequency, what is the term used to describe this situation?
questions.solution: If two values appear with the same highest frequency, the distribution is called bimodal. Unimodal refers to a single mode, trimodal refers to three modes, and multimodal refers to more than two modes. This understanding goes beyond the basic definition and requires an insight into the classification of distributions.

hi.stem: एक बारंबारता वितरण सारणी में, मोड की परिभाषा वह मान है जो सबसे अधिक बार आता है। यदि दो मान समान उच्चतम बारंबारता के साथ आते हैं, तो इस स्थिति के लिए क्या शब्द प्रयोग किया जाता है?

questions.stem: If the median of a data set is 32.5, which of the following could be the number of observations?
questions.solution: The median of a data set is the middle value when the numbers are ordered. If the number of observations is even, the median is the average of the two middle numbers. For the median to be 32.5, the two middle numbers must be 32 and 33, which requires an even number of observations. Only 10 observations allow for this situation. Options with an odd number of observations would result in a single middle number, not an average of two.
